lease.page: FRAMEWORK-EDITS E70, applied 2026-08-30 to an IFRS 16 filer IFRS 16.50(b): a lessee classifies cash payments for the principal portion of the lease liability within FINANCING activities, so this filer's `operating_cash_flow` never bore the principal; the interest portion follows the filer's IAS 7 policy, which `interest_in_ocf` records. The standard leaves no choice on the principal
